title: IncuBrix CreatorOps Platform Launch

copy.headline: Scale your content workflow effortlessly
copy.support: Discover, create, repurpose and publish across all platforms from one hub.

concept: A warm, elegant hub-and-orbit visual metaphor showcasing the unified CreatorOps workflow for modern creators and builders.

design_system.style: Sophisticated vector illustration with smooth gradients, warm glowing highlights, and soft layered shadows.
design_system.lighting: Warm soft light from top-left casting gentle depth across floating geometric nodes.

composition.hero: A central glowing golden core ringed by four floating rounded nodes representing discover, create, repurpose, and publish, connected by thin luminous gradient lines.
props: Golden starburst sparkles floating around the central hub
Soft glowing gradient spheres drifting in the background
composition.background: Deep violet-charcoal vertical gradient with an expansive warm golden glow behind the central hero.
decor: Large faint overlapping geometric arcs in translucent amber
